framework: DRAS India Model V3 Error Taxonomy
primary_error_source: Cloud & Atmospheric Occlusion (34.2%) followed by Mountainous Shadowing (26.5%)

categories.hazard_context: Monsoon Landslides & Cyclones (Wayanad 2024, Kerala 2018, Cyclone Fani 2019)
categories.mechanism: Heavy monsoon cloud cover, cirrus streaks, and rain-induced atmospheric scattering obscure optical reflectance bands (B02-B04).
categories.model_behavior: Optical models produce false negatives or low confidence (<0.35) under dense cloud shadows.
categories.mitigation_implemented: Integration of Sentinel-1 C-band SAR backscatter difference (Exp 4 & Model D), which penetrates cloud cover and rain cells to detect ground surface disruption.

categories.hazard_context: Himalayan Flash Floods & Debris Flows (Chamoli 2021, Dharali 2025, Himachal 2023)
categories.mechanism: Steep valley walls in Garhwal and Kullu cast long solar shadows in winter/early spring morning satellite passes.
categories.model_behavior: Low radiometric dynamic range inside shadowed gorges reduces building boundary contrast, causing perimeter under-segmentation.
categories.mitigation_implemented: Radiometric contrast equalization, multi-scale feature pyramids in U-Net++, and DEM slope feature conditioning.

categories.hazard_context: Hyperconcentrated Ice-Rock Avalanches & GLOFs (Raini/Tapovan in Chamoli 2021, Chungthang in Sikkim 2023)
categories.mechanism: Structures located directly along active riverbeds are sheared away at foundation level and buried beneath 5-15m of boulders and silt.
categories.model_behavior: Post-disaster images show bare grey mud and rock with zero residual wall outlines, tempting models to predict 'Background' rather than 'Destroyed'.
categories.mitigation_implemented: Pre+Post bi-temporal difference modeling ensures that a building present in the pre-disaster footprint that vanishes into a scoured debris path is assigned the Destroyed class.

categories.hazard_context: Coastal Urban Centers (Puri in Cyclone Fani, Chennai in Michaung 2023)
categories.mechanism: Shared contiguous tin and asbestos roofs with narrow (<1m) alleys between adjacent properties.
categories.model_behavior: Building localisation tends to merge multiple adjacent dwelling units into single large polygonal blobs.
categories.mitigation_implemented: Instance-level boundary erosion loss (Dice + Boundary IoU) and Microsoft Open Buildings footprint priors.

categories.hazard_context: Cross-sensor / off-nadir optical imagery (Sentinel-2 vs Cartosat-2S)
categories.mechanism: Variations in satellite view angle (>15 degrees off-nadir) cause tall structures to lean in opposite directions between pre and post acquisitions.
categories.model_behavior: Spatial misalignment creates artificial edge difference artifacts mistaken for structural damage.
categories.mitigation_implemented: Automatic normalized cross-correlation (NCC) sub-pixel registration and strict alignment validation.
